900000001.title: Simple egg fried rice
steps: If starting with dry rice, cook it following its package directions first. Measure 2 cups of cooked rice and break up any clumps.
Beat the eggs in a bowl. Heat half the butter or oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Add the eggs and stir until set. Transfer them to a plate.
Add the remaining fat and rice to the pan. Stir-fry for 3–5 minutes until the rice is hot throughout.
Return the eggs to the pan, break them into pieces, and stir through the rice. Serve hot.
900000001.note: A basic three-ingredient version. Cook dry rice before starting the frying steps.

900000002.title: Tomato garlic pasta
quantities: 1 tablespoon olive oil or vegetable oil
steps: Cook the pasta in a saucepan of boiling water following its package directions. Reserve half a cup of the cooking water, then drain.
Warm the oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Add the garlic and stir for about 30 seconds.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 10–15 minutes, stirring and pressing them with a spoon until they form a sauce.
Add the drained pasta. Toss with a splash of the reserved cooking water to loosen the sauce, then serve.
900000002.note: Any everyday dried pasta shape works. The tomatoes provide the sauce.

900000003.title: Potato and onion skillet
quantities: 400 g potatoes, cut into 1 cm cubes
steps: Place the potato cubes in a saucepan and cover with water. Bring to a boil and simmer for 6–8 minutes, until just tender. Drain well.
Heat the butter or oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring.
Add the drained potatoes in an even layer. Cook for 10–15 minutes, turning occasionally, until tender and golden.
Check a potato with a fork. Continue cooking if its centre is firm, then serve.
900000003.note: Cutting the potatoes evenly helps them cook at the same rate.

900000004.title: Chickpea and spinach skillet
quantities: 1 tablespoon olive oil or vegetable oil
steps: Use cooked chickpeas. If starting with dried chickpeas, soak and cook them according to the package instructions before beginning.
Warm the oil in a pan over medium-low heat. Stir in the garlic for about 30 seconds.
Add the drained chickpeas and 3 tablespoons of water. Cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the spinach in handfuls. Stir until it wilts, then cook until the chickpeas are hot throughout. Serve.
900000004.note: Dried chickpeas need soaking and cooking first. Water for cooking is assumed.
